ios.desc:
Welcome to Greg, the zero-guesswork plant care app & community!

We make growing indoor plants super easy and fun.

Unsure of how much to water your plant babies? We got you! We'll identify your specific plant type, tell you exactly how much to water it, and remind you when it's time.

By downloading Greg, you also join a global community of other passionate plant parents ready to answer questions, nerd out on all things plants, and offer big-time garden inspo.

With Greg, it's all about connecting to plants - and each other - to stay reminded of just how interconnected we *all* are on this big, beautiful planet of ours.

So, whaddya say? Wanna grow together? Download Greg and let's get started!

-> FEATURES
 
Auto-Magical Plant Identification
- Scan any plant (for free!) and Greg’s PlantVision will identify the species, tell you all about it, measure the pot, and even the distance to the nearest window
 
Highly-personalized plant care
- Trust Greg to develop a custom watering plan based on each plant's species, size, plus the actual details of your home environment

Zero-guesswork watering & reminders
- Discover *exactly* how much each of your plants is thirsty for, and get a reminder when it's time to water 'em

Community troubleshooting
- Turn to more veteran growers for answers to any plant questions you have, and get an answer in minutes

Thriving global community
- Connect with others in #Communities built around shared interests & discover/interact with new plant pals in the app's Social Feed

More to come!
- We're always looking to grow, so stay tuned for new features as we have 'em…

-> USER REVIEWS

- "Definitely worth it for someone passionate about plants" - Tree2727
- "Greg is by far the best plant app I've used" - LolaCupcake586369954
- "10/10 have recommended to so many friends so far!" - FireySpirit711
- "This app is a literal life saver for my plants." - Lemonlaw625
- "I've killed every plant I've touched, so this is exactly what I needed!" - 21JazzCat

-> PRICING

For $29.99 a year (less than $0.08 a day) unlock:

Precision Watering
-Find out how much H2O each plant needs and never overwater again!

Smart Watering Reminders
-Receive a notification when each of your plants is ready for watering.

Indoor Light Gauge
-Ensure that all your plants are getting enough sunshine to survive.

Seasonal Updates
-Get plant care recs that adapt as the weather in your area changes.

You could use Greg [0] to learn how to grow plants. Disclosure: I'm one of the co-creators :). There's also a thriving community [1] that has become honestly surprisingly healthy/supportive. Think "Strava for growing plants".

We're still early, any feedback is appreciated. We raised our seed round [2] last year, check out that announcement for more info on our long-term mission.
